simulator_source_chain.architecture: ChatCompletion -> EvalScope OpenAI parser -> ChatMessageAssistant/ContentReasoning + tool calls -> ModelOutput -> frozen patched_generate -> Tau2 AssistantMessage(raw_data=ModelOutput dump) -> Tau2 user simulator state/flip_roles or agent state -> to_litellm_messages -> EvalScope dict_to_chat_message -> openai_chat_message(reasoning_field) -> next Chat wire.
simulator_source_chain.report:
Exact loss/preservation chain: (1) EvalScope receives a native response in OpenAICompatibleAPI.generate (evalscope/models/openai_compatible.py:102-160). Its parser recognizes only `reasoning_content`/`reasoning` (evalscope/models/utils/openai.py:610-635), turns the value into `ContentReasoning(reasoning=..., reasoning_tokens=...)`, turns visible response into ContentText, and separately parses tool calls. `model_output_from_openai` retains id/model/typed choices/usage only (openai.py:638-661); ModelOutput has no raw provider-response slot (api/model/model_output.py:99-151). Therefore unknown native fields such as thinkingSignature, encrypted reasoning, or providerPayload are not semantically extracted. OpenAI SDK models allow extras (openai/_models.py:116-130), but the EvalScope parser ignores them; no source evidence says they reach ModelOutput.

(2) Frozen adapter receives that ModelOutput. It calls `message.text` and converts EvalScope tool calls; `raw_data` is `completion.model_dump(...)` (tau3_adapter.py:257-285), so it captures the transformed ModelOutput only, not the original HTTP ChatCompletion. `_reasoning_from_tau_message` searches only raw_data choices[0].message content blocks with type=reasoning or a string message.reasoning (tau3_adapter.py:85-105). It does not search signature/thinkingSignature/encrypted/providerPayload. It injects only string `reasoning` into an EvalScope payload (tau3_adapter.py:138-153), and `dict_to_chat_message` makes ContentReasoning (chat_message.py:130-145). 

(3) For normal assistant output, Tau2 stores content/tool_calls/raw_data (tau2/data_model/message.py:199-220). For a tool-only response, EvalScope `ChatMessageBase.text` returns only text blocks (chat_message.py:39-58), so frozen adapter sets Tau2 content to None while retaining tool_calls and raw_data (tau3_adapter.py:270-285). The adapter's model-input conversion sets empty assistant content to `''` when tool_calls exist, preserving the action for the next request (tau3_adapter.py:138-153). 

(4) Tau2 simulator path: UserSimulator appends incoming message, builds `system + state.flip_roles()`, then calls generate (tau2/user/user_simulator.py:231-249). Its generated EvalScope/Tau2 assistant is wrapped into UserMessage with visible content, usage/cost, and raw_data copied (user_simulator.py:254-261); generated tool calls become requestor=user (user_simulator.py:262-273). On the next simulator request, flip_roles reconstructs UserMessage as AssistantMessage and non-tool AssistantMessage as UserMessage with only role/content/tool_calls; raw_data and reasoning metadata are dropped (user_simulator_base.py:62-105). 

(5) Agent path appends incoming message then invokes generate using state messages (tau2/agent/llm_agent.py:105-134). At either next Chat call, Tau2 `to_litellm_messages` keeps only role/content/tool_calls for AssistantMessage, role/content for UserMessage, and role/content/tool_call_id for ToolMessage (tau2/utils/llm_utils.py:160-207). It always drops raw_data, so frozen adapter cannot recover reasoning after this conversion unless it was re-injected before conversion; its re-injection still handles only plain reasoning text. 

(6) EvalScope serializer: `openai_chat_message` routes assistant messages to `_openai_assistant_message_param` (evalscope/models/utils/openai.py:143-212). In `reasoning_field` mode it drops reasoning from content and emits only the last ContentReasoning.reasoning as top-level `reasoning_content`; no signature/encrypted/provider payload is emitted. `openai_assistant_content` can preserve EvalScope `.internal` only via a base64 `<internal>` tag (openai.py:302-347), but frozen adapter never populates internal from native fields. 

Preserved: visible text (as Tau2 content), parsed tool-call id/name/arguments, usage, generic transformed ModelOutput dump in raw_data until flip_roles/to_litellm conversion, plain reasoning text when frozen adapter's custom extractor sees EvalScope reasoning blocks. Lost/unsupported: original provider response, native thinkingSignature/signature association (response parser does not copy it), encrypted/redacted reasoning payload, providerPayload, and any metadata after Tau2 flip_roles or to_litellm_messages. Tool-only assistant calls are preserved structurally by frozen adapter (content placeholder only on model-input conversion), but a tool-only UserMessage's user tool_calls are not emitted by Tau2's stock to_litellm converter. Source capability statements above are not claims that those fields existed in any historical live output; no historical live artifact was read.

artifact_inventory.architecture: Two distinct retained formats are present. Native provider boundary captures use one JSON record per SSE frame (`provider.sse.send`/`provider.sse.receive`, with response.* frame types). Chat gateway captures use event=request/response records or chat.completion JSON and store assistant `tool_calls` in conversation/request history. Fidelity session-control safety logs intentionally retain hashes and coarse event summaries rather than native bodies. The only explicit native phase observed is phase=final_answer on empty/text message output items; there is no native toolcall phase or signature evidence.
artifact_inventory.report: Evidence and absence boundaries: (1) exact-key/type searches over the two wire provider-frame files found no `"encrypted_content":`, `"reasoning_content":`, `response.reasoning*`, signature/thought_signature, or native function/custom/computer call item/event. Their receive records are message output items and output_text events only. (2) Exact native-event searches over fidelity JSONL locate native_request records only in session-control-native-20260906T0535Z and the synthetic session-capture-safety files; the former retains hashed request metadata plus empty output_text/completed summaries, while the latter is model=test text-only safety data. The 0530/0533 session-control files are empty. (3) The fidelity protocol capture's visible `type=reasoning` content is a Chat/qwen record with null signature, not a native encrypted item; do not use it to infer native metadata, phases, or continuation signatures. (4) Chat toolcall blocks in wire simulator JSON and fidelity .sent.json are request-history/tool-call records, not native SSE responses. Therefore no exact native pre-application/toolcall reasoning or encrypted-content artifact is available in either requested worktree; the strongest retained native evidence is the empty/text-only SSE/message output and hashed session-control summaries, with `phase=final_answer` only on message items.
